newsitem.title: UK: BZW dismisses loss reports as speculation.
newsitem.headline: BZW dismisses loss reports as speculation.

text.p: BZW, the investment banking arm of Britain's Barclays Plc, on Monday dismissed as speculation reports it had sustained heavy losses in its equities division.
"This is rumour and speculation. We never comment on our trading," a BZW spokesman said.
He confirmed the departure of Mike Gaeton, BZW's deputy head of proprietary trading in its equities division, but declined to give any detail on why he had left the firm.
"We just can't comment on individuals," the BZW spokesman told Reuters when asked if Gaeton's contract had been honoured.
Gaeton, who newspapers said had resigned from his position at BZW, had been at the firm for at least 10 years, he added.
